_comment: DP-GEN concurrent-learning (active learning) parameter file. DP-GEN closes the loop: train an ensemble -> run exploratory MD -> pick frames where the ensemble DISAGREES (high force deviation) -> label those with DFT -> retrain. This is how you build a robust MLP with the FEWEST expensive DFT calls -- essential for the confined, high-pressure states that matter for desalination.

default_training_param._comment: Inherits model/descriptor from deepmd_input.json; DP-GEN trains numb_models copies with different seeds to form the query-by-committee ensemble.

_comment_trust: Frames with max force deviation between model_devi_f_trust_lo and _hi (eV/A) are 'candidates' worth labelling. Below lo = already learned; above hi = unphysical/exploded, discard.

model_devi_jobs._comment: Explore at desalination-relevant pressures (up to hundreds of bar/MPa) so the training set covers the piston-driven states.

_comment_fp: First-principles labelling engine. Switch to 'qe' + a pw.x template to stay all-open-source (see 02_dft/qe).
